archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & SWISS B2B TECH

typography.editorial_italic: Newsreader, Georgia, serif (Newsreader retained only for occasional editorial italic copy)

rules.anti_default: Never use Inter, Roboto, or Arial for headings or main hero titles.

rules.forbidden: Do NOT use #7351B7 or #1B93A4. Never use un-tinted #000000 or #808080.
rules.contrast: All normal text must meet AA standards (4.5:1 ratio minimum). Text over 3D scenes or dark backgrounds must use bg-black/40 backdrop blur or gradient scrims.
rules.theme_mode: Support both Light (lavender #F5ECFF) and Dark (cinematic navy #0A0F1C) mode toggle seamlessly.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/60 border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10 shadow-lg
visual_enhancers.card_styling: Subtle 8px border-radius, dark elevation #0E1728 on dark mode, soft hover lift (-translate-y-1) and glow border transition.
visual_enhancers.3d_interactive: Retain Three.js R3F financial workspace scene with interactive 3D elements (DCF model laptop, chart bars, concall analyzer canvas) + SVG fallback for high performance.
visual_enhancers.workflow_canvas: Interactive illustrative workflow scene for Enterprise AI agents (Financial Statement Ingestion -> Concall NLP Analysis -> Auto DCF -> Governance Audit) with step highlights and animation.

audience_gateway.concept: Split user experience (Student vs Enterprise) with a top persistent Audience Switcher toggle ('For Students' / 'For Enterprise') and a first-visit Audience Selection Modal/Hero segment.
audience_gateway.student_focus: Mastering Finance, NISM Certification, Capstone DCF Models, AI Mock Interviews, Career Placement.
audience_gateway.enterprise_focus: 10x Productivity, AI Automation Agents (Bookkeeping, FP&A, Concall Analysis, Excel Governance), Custom Enterprise Slabs, Corporate Agent Training.

sections: Hero Section with Audience Switcher, 10x ROI Value Prop, Interactive 3D/Canvas Workflow Scene
Enterprise Products vs Training dual-path selector (Buy Built Agents vs In-house Agent Training)
Enterprise Content Modules (Real-world Valuation, Concall Case Studies, Deep FP&A, Excel Governance)
Tiered Seat Slab Calculator (1-10 seats, 11-50 seats, 51-200 seats, Enterprise Unlimited) with live price estimate and Instant Enquiry trigger
Enterprise Resend-powered Email Enquiry Form (Name, Work Email, Company, Team Size, Requirements)
Enterprise Client Case Studies / ROI Metrics (10x faster concall summary, 80% manual FP&A saved)

resources_marketplace.checkout_flow: Razorpay payment integration with instant unlock and secure private download access.
resources_marketplace.admin_panel: Resource Management (/admin/resources): Upload templates, set prices/discount, view sales/leads, configure Resend email settings.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element (audience toggle buttons, seat slab inputs, enquiry submit form, resource filters, checkout CTA, admin buttons) MUST have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain existing Student pages and 3D visual philosophy while adding the Enterprise tier experience.
Ensure persistent Audience Switcher (Student vs Enterprise) across landing, header, course catalog, and details pages.
Implement Enterprise Landing page at /enterprise with 10x ROI message, dynamic tiered seat calculator, interactive workflow scene, and Resend email enquiry form.
Build Resources & Templates Marketplace (/resources) supporting 5 categories, Razorpay purchase flow, private download links, and Admin panel management (/admin/resources).
Add explicit data-testid attributes on all new interactive components.
Maintain theme toggle compatibility (Light Lavender vs Dark Navy) without broken contrast or missing borders.
